findings.evidence: TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Pi.lean:113 `public def piEquivPiSubtypeProd : ((i : ι) → M i) ≃ₗ[R] ((i : {x : ι // p x}) → M i) × ((i : {x : ι // ¬p x}) → M i) where toEquiv := Equiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd p M; map_add' _ _ := rfl; map_smul' _ _ := rfl`, with simp lemmas at :120 and :125.
findings.fix: Delete it. Import `TauCeti.LinearAlgebra.Pi` and use `LinearEquiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd A (fun j ↦ (∏ i, ε j i) = 1) (fun j ↦ (linearMap (fun i ↦ (ε j i : A)) (M := A)).fixedSubmodule)` (under `classical`). Simp proofs can then use `LinearEquiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd_apply` instead of unfolding `Equiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd`.
findings.issue: Private `splitPiLinearEquiv` is directly replaced by the existing `LinearEquiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd`: same `Equiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd` with `rfl` `map_add'`/`map_smul'`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Int/Units.lean:45 `lemma isUnit_iff : IsUnit u ↔ u = 1 ∨ u = -1`; Mathlib/Algebra/BigOperators/Group/Finset/Basic.lean:1162 `lemma IsUnit.prod_univ_iff ... : IsUnit (∏ a, f a) ↔ ∀ a, IsUnit (f a)`.
findings.fix: Replace the body with `Int.isUnit_iff.mp (IsUnit.prod_univ_iff.mpr fun i ↦ Int.isUnit_iff.mpr (hε j i))`, or inline it at the two use sites.
findings.issue: `sign_prod` re-proves by Finset induction that a product of ±1 integers is ±1.

findings.evidence: `Equiv.subtypeEquivRight : (∀ x, p x ↔ q x) → {x // p x} ≃ {x // q x}` is the standard Mathlib combinator for this.
findings.fix: Use `Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun j ↦ ⟨(sign_prod ε hε j).resolve_left, fun h ↦ by rw [h]; norm_num⟩`.
findings.issue: `negativeIndexEquiv` hand-builds a predicate equality via `funext`/`propext` for `Equiv.subtypeEquivProp`. `Equiv.subtypeEquivRight` takes the pointwise iff directly.

findings.evidence: grep for `fixedBasisEquiv|fixedEquivTorsionOfBasis|repr_eq_partialProd_mul|WeightedCycle.Basis` in TauCeti/ only hits WeightedCycle/Basis.lean and WeightedCycle/Basic.lean; Basis.lean:37-53 has the same proof shape as Family/Basic.lean:36-64.
findings.fix: Keep one canonical API. Either remove `WeightedCycle/Basis.lean` (the family version with `J := Unit` covers it) or derive the single-cycle statements from the family ones. Do not maintain both proofs.
findings.issue: The family API repeats the existing single-cycle API in `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/WeightedCycle/Basis.lean` declaration for declaration (`equivFun_comp_eq_linearMap_comp`, `fixedBasisEquiv`(_apply/_symm_apply), `repr_eq_partialProd_mul`, `fixedEquivTorsionOfBasis`(_apply/_symm_apply)). `equivFun_comp_eq_piMap_comp` copies the same proof (`ext` over the reindexed basis, `finRotate` surjectivity, `linearMap_apply_rotate`, case split). The single-cycle file has no consumers, so this leaves two parallel APIs.

summary: The private `splitPiLinearEquiv` is a copy of the existing `LinearEquiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd`, and `sign_prod`/`negativeIndexEquiv` re-derive Mathlib facts. The new family API repeats the unused single-cycle API in `WeightedCycle/Basis.lean` declaration for declaration.
